newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit in range as market thins ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit in range as market thins ahead of holiday.

text.p: The ringgit was bound in a tight trading range as market thinned further ahead of two major festivals in Malaysia, dealers said on Wednesday.
They said most players were just squaring up their positions ahead of the Chinese New Year and Moslem Eid al-Fitr festivals.
Malaysian banks are closed from Friday through Tuesday for the twin celebrations.

"There are hardly any players and hardly any calls," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank in Kuala Lumpur. He said the market was squaring up long ringgit positions because there were usually sharp movements in the ringgit after the festivals.
"The market is still bullish ringgit. There should be some dollar selling soon around the current levels," said a dealer with another Malaysian bank.
He said an uptrend in ringgit was held up by a strong dollar/majors and the festivals.
The ringgit gained over two percent against the dollar at the start of the year before retreating on profit-taking. It has been trading in a wide 2.48/2.50 range in the last few days.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4942/52 a dollar.
